name: 16363-offlinegen-qwen06b-8gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B. Ungated, ~1.2 GB, trivially cached. Part of the declaration -- not to be swapped for a larger checkpoint.
parallelism: TP=8 with data-parallel attention over all eight (dp-size 8, enable-dp-attention), so attn_tp_size = 1: each rank attends over its own request slice and holds the full 8 KV heads (112 KiB of bf16 KV per token), while the MLP stays tensor-parallel across all eight. EP=1, PP=1.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 0.6B dense, bf16, unquantized: 28 layers, hidden 1024, GQA 16 query over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=800, bounded at 800 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, seed 42, no warmup window. All 800 are released at t=0 and the run ends when the last one clears, so throughput is the inverse of the makespan of a fixed request set.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix: prompt ~15000 tokens (stdev 8660, clamped 1-30000), output ~250 tokens (stdev 144, clamped 1-500). ~12.2 M tokens in the run, about 98% of it on the input side; temperature 0.0 and ignore_eos true, so every request emits exactly the length it drew.
purpose: A bulk document-analysis service summarizing very long reports, 800 jobs at once, on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id:`; the interpreter is named by
# configs/env.yaml `venv:`.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B

# The checkpoint ships custom code paths in its repo; required to load it without a
# warning-to-error at some transformers versions.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8
dp-size: 8
enable-dp-attention: true

# HAZARD: with the environment variable in configs/tuned.yaml set, the engine asserts fcfs
# scheduling, DP attention, no disaggregation and the overlap scheduler on, and a launch violating
# any of the four aborts rather than degrading.
schedule-policy: fcfs

max-total-tokens: 200000
mem-fraction-static: 0.6
chunked-prefill-size: 131072
